chunks: And in the narration of Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said:
One dirham of usury is more severe in the sight of Allah than seventy acts of fornication, all of them being with a forbidden relative.

key_terms.أَشَدُّ: more severe or graver in sin
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a single dirham; even a small amount of unlawful gain
key_terms.رِبًا: usury; unlawful increase in a financial transaction
key_terms.مَحْرَمٍ: a forbidden relative whom one may not lawfully marry

ai.seo_question: How serious is riba according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the extreme gravity of riba in the sight of Allah. It uses a severe comparison to show that usury is not merely a financial violation, but a major moral and legal transgression with destructive social consequences.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3992 - In a narration from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:
"One dirham of usury is more severe in the sight of Allah (swt) than seventy acts of fornication, all of which are committed with forbidden relatives."
